component.name: lilbee-cuda
component.summary: Local search engine you can talk to (NVIDIA CUDA build)

description.p: lilbee runs and manages local AI models, indexes your files and code, crawls the web pages you point it at, and answers questions with citations down to the file and line. One install covers the TUI, CLI, HTTP server, and MCP server. It works with your own Ollama or LM Studio models too.

This build offloads inference to an NVIDIA GPU via CUDA. It needs a recent NVIDIA proprietary driver on the host; without a usable GPU it falls back to the CPU. Run it with GPU access enabled (flatpak --device=all).
